hook_anchors.excerpt: Rupert is rotting in the undercroft cells. Not me. I intend to stay on this estate.
hook_anchors.why: Establishes immediate defiance and malicious intent from a character trying to secure her place.

hook_anchors.excerpt: She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road.
hook_anchors.why: Harsh, decisive rejection by Lady Ashbourne creates high stakes for the destitute Catherine.
A stunning power reversal where the vengeful rival is forced into menial servitude.

hook_anchors.excerpt: You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor.
hook_anchors.why: Direct and biting psychological dominance delivered right to the antagonist's face.
Captures the raw, broken pride of a once-haughty villain brought completely low.

cliffhanger_anchors.open_question: Why does Juliana stop the guards from throwing Catherine out?
cliffhanger_anchors.why: Interrupts the expected punishment, shifting the power dynamic entirely.

cliffhanger_anchors.open_question: Will Catherine swallow her pride and accept the humiliating terms?
cliffhanger_anchors.excerpt: One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing.
cliffhanger_anchors.why: Puts an ultimatum on the line that tests whether the proud villain can survive as a servant.

cliffhanger_anchors.open_question: How will Catherine endure her new life of complete degradation at Ashbourne?
cliffhanger_anchors.why: The final submission leaves the viewer wondering what kind of vengeance or conflict will brew next.
